name: Rakuschev Mlin
zag_role: Report about the condition of the building known as Rakuschev mlin, after exposure to fire
description: Report about the condition of the building known as Rakuschev mlin, after exposure to fire.
history: The mill in Gaberje, also known as Prvi mestni mlin Celje, was built in 1903 and was a cultural monument of local importance. Fire damaged it in October 2014, and demolition began on 4 April 2015, so the building no longer stands.
facts: former mill site in Gaberje, from the Google Maps place pin
